_: The painted corner (reviews/lt1/art-direction/README.md, What matters): every value the engine frame is drawn with (LT1ArtPasses.Paint, PaintSurface.shader, PaintAir.shader). Colours are sRGB hex (made linear, times a); positions and directions are street metres (x east, y north, z up). Nothing here is a fact except the lamps' places and the houses' coats, which are read from their own records.
